target_customer: Retailers, fashion brands and influencers running drop-ship programs
problem: Selling fashion online without inventory risk requires connecting brands' inventory to online stores, which is manual and fragmented.
business_model: B2B marketplace and drop-ship software with transaction revenue

founders.name: Leandrew Robinson
previous_startups: Ecommerce businesses reported at about 500M USD in sales (per YC page)

founders.name: Akintunde Ismail Maiyegun
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating brand inventory feeds, store platforms and order routing across many partners is standard but integration-heavy engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Partner integrations and two-sided supply give some stickiness, but drop-ship tooling was open to copying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DiCentral, a B2B integration provider, bought the company in September 2020; some reports describe an asset purchase.

market_need_then: Fashion retailers wanted lower inventory risk; the YC description frames zero inventory risk selling as the value. No dated independent demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used hingeto.com; the site returned HTTP 503 during this research.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand-focused press or community evidence found; the brand disappeared into DiCentral after 2020.

outcome_analysis: Hingeto built a drop-ship marketplace for fashion brands, graduated YC in Winter 2016 and raised a seed with Kapor Capital, Cross Culture Ventures and Precursor. In September 2020 DiCentral bought it for an undisclosed price, reported by some outlets as an asset purchase with founders consulting afterward. The price and whether investors profited are not public.
notes: Unverified: Seedtable lists a seed of about 1.9M USD in July 2016 with conflicting lead (Cross Culture Ventures vs Kapor); amount not recorded. Investor list comes from the company's YC description. Robinson later became general manager of ShipStation (Auctane) per reports in 2020; the acquisition did not involve Auctane in any source. DiCentral was itself acquired by TrueCommerce in September 2021. No dated competitor sources near 2016 were found.
